method: JRC Walraven 2008 slides83-87, thin-wall torsion at theta45; C30 fcd17/nu0.528, four H16 ties, same-state longitudinal reserve before biaxial bending. Authored comparison only, not current-code compliance. The 5% steel reserve and cast -10/setout5 challenges are requirements to qualify, not delivered bounds. K uses nominal sections; minimum-section stiffness, longitudinal shear-shift anchorage and full all-head transfer remain open.
